column1: Looking for Inscryption in your Steam library.

column2: 已找到 Inscryption：{0}。

column2: 在你的 Steam 收藏庫中找不到 Inscryption。

column1: Type or paste the full path of your Inscryption folder, then press Enter. Or just press Enter to quit.
column2: 輸入或貼上 Inscryption 資料夾的完整路徑，然後按 Enter 鍵。或者只按 Enter 鍵結束。

column1: That folder does not contain Inscryption.exe.
column2: 該資料夾中沒有 Inscryption.exe。

column1: IKMA version {0} is installed and turned on.
column2: IKMA 版本 {0} 已安裝並已開啟。

column1: IKMA is installed and turned on.
column2: IKMA 已安裝並已開啟。

column1: IKMA version {0} is installed but turned off. Inscryption starts without it.
column2: IKMA 版本 {0} 已安裝，但已關閉。Inscryption 會在沒有它的情況下啟動。

column1: IKMA is installed but turned off. Inscryption starts without it.
column2: IKMA 已安裝，但已關閉。Inscryption 會在沒有它的情況下啟動。

column1: IKMA is not installed in this game folder.
column2: 此遊戲資料夾中未安裝 IKMA。

column1: Main menu. Press Enter alone to install or update IKMA. Or type a number, then press Enter. 1, install or update. 2, settings. 3, turn IKMA back on. 4, uninstall. 5, quit.
column2: 主選單。只按 Enter 鍵即可安裝或更新 IKMA。或者輸入一個數字，然後按 Enter 鍵。1，安裝或更新。2，設定。3，重新開啟 IKMA。4，解除安裝。5，結束。

column1: Main menu. Press Enter alone to install or update IKMA. Or type a number, then press Enter. 1, install or update. 2, settings. 3, turn IKMA off. 4, uninstall. 5, quit.
column2: 主選單。只按 Enter 鍵即可安裝或更新 IKMA。或者輸入一個數字，然後按 Enter 鍵。1，安裝或更新。2，設定。3，關閉 IKMA。4，解除安裝。5，結束。

column1: That is not one of the choices.
column2: 這不是可選的選項。

column1: IKMA is not installed, so there is nothing to turn off.
column2: IKMA 未安裝，所以沒有可以關閉的東西。

column1: IKMA is turned off. Inscryption starts without it. BepInEx and your other mods are unchanged, and IKMA's settings are kept.
column2: IKMA 已關閉。Inscryption 會在沒有它的情況下啟動。BepInEx 和你的其他模組維持不變，IKMA 的設定也會保留。

column1: IKMA is turned back on. It starts with the game.
column2: IKMA 已重新開啟。它會隨遊戲一起啟動。

column1: IKMA was turned off. Installing turned it back on.
column2: IKMA 先前已關閉。安裝時已將它重新開啟。

column1: Settings. Type a number, then press Enter to change it. Press Enter alone to go back to the main menu. Changes take effect the next time you start the game.
column2: 設定。輸入一個數字，然後按 Enter 鍵進行變更。只按 Enter 鍵返回主選單。變更會在下次啟動遊戲時生效。

column1: {0}. Type a number, then press Enter. Press Enter alone to keep it as it is.
column2: {0}。輸入一個數字，然後按 Enter 鍵。只按 Enter 鍵維持不變。

column1: {0}, {1} This is the current setting.
column2: {0}，{1} 這是目前的設定。

column1: {0} set to: {1}
a custom value, {0}.
Updates
column2: 更新

column1: Speech engine
column2: 語音引擎

column1: Language
column2: 語言

column1: Full log for bug reports
column2: 用於錯誤回報的完整記錄檔

column1: Inscryption is running. Close the game, then press Enter.
column2: Inscryption 正在執行。請關閉遊戲，然後按 Enter 鍵。

column1: This Inscryption is not the 32-bit version this installer was made for. Nothing was changed.
column2: 此 Inscryption 不是本安裝程式所針對的 32 位元版本。未做任何變更。

column1: BepInEx is already installed. Kept as it is.
column2: BepInEx 已安裝。維持原樣。

column1: Installed BepInEx, the mod loader.
column2: 已安裝模組載入器 BepInEx。

column1: Installed IKMA and its speech files.
column2: 已安裝 IKMA 及其語音檔案。

column1: Done. Start Inscryption from Steam as usual. IKMA will speak at the title screen.
column2: 完成。像平常一樣從 Steam 啟動 Inscryption。IKMA 會在標題畫面開始說話。

column1: IKMA is uninstalled. BepInEx was left in place, because other mods may use it.
column2: IKMA 已解除安裝。BepInEx 保留在原處，因為其他模組可能會用到它。

column1: IKMA was not installed in this folder.
column2: 此資料夾中沒有安裝 IKMA。

column1: Windows would not let the installer write to the game folder. Close this window, right-click IKMA_Manager and choose Run as administrator.
column2: Windows 不允許安裝程式寫入遊戲資料夾。請關閉此視窗，在 IKMA_Manager 上按滑鼠右鍵，然後選擇「以系統管理員身分執行」。

column1: This installer is incomplete: a file it carries is missing. Download it again.
column2: 此安裝程式不完整：缺少它應包含的一個檔案。請重新下載。

column1: Something went wrong, and the install stopped: {0}
column2: 發生問題，安裝已停止：{0}

column1: Press Enter to close.
column2: 按 Enter 鍵關閉。

column1: BepInEx {0} is already installed for your other mods. Kept exactly as it is.
column2: BepInEx {0} 已為你的其他模組安裝。完全維持原樣。

column1: This game has BepInEx 6 installed. IKMA needs BepInEx 5, and replacing it would break your other mods. Nothing was changed.
column2: 此遊戲安裝了 BepInEx 6。IKMA 需要 BepInEx 5，取代它會破壞你的其他模組。未做任何變更。

column1: This game has another mod loader installed ({0}). Adding BepInEx beside it could break your other mods. Nothing was changed.
column2: 此遊戲安裝了另一個模組載入器（{0}）。在旁邊加入 BepInEx 可能會破壞你的其他模組。未做任何變更。

column1: The BepInEx in this game folder is the 64-bit build, which cannot load in this 32-bit game. Nothing was changed; it needs the 32-bit BepInEx.
column2: 此遊戲資料夾中的 BepInEx 是 64 位元版本，無法在這個 32 位元遊戲中載入。未做任何變更；需要 32 位元的 BepInEx。

column1: BepInEx is here, but the file that starts it with the game (winhttp.dll) is missing. Type Y and press Enter to add it. Press Enter alone to leave everything as it is.
column2: BepInEx 已存在，但缺少讓它隨遊戲啟動的檔案（winhttp.dll）。輸入 Y 並按 Enter 鍵加入它。只按 Enter 鍵則一切維持不變。

column1: Added the file that starts BepInEx.
column2: 已加入啟動 BepInEx 的檔案。

column1: Left BepInEx as it is. IKMA is installed but will not load until BepInEx starts with the game.
column2: BepInEx 維持原樣。IKMA 已安裝，但在 BepInEx 隨遊戲啟動之前不會載入。

column1: Note: BepInEx is switched off in doorstop_config.ini (enabled=false). IKMA will not load until it is switched on. The installer did not change it.
column2: 注意：doorstop_config.ini 中關閉了 BepInEx（enabled=false）。在它開啟之前，IKMA 不會載入。安裝程式沒有變更它。

column1: Found an earlier IKMA at {0}. Updated it there.
column2: 在 {0} 找到了較早的 IKMA，已在原位置更新。

column1: More than one copy of IKMA is installed: {0}. Remove all but one, then run this again. Nothing was changed.
column2: 安裝了多個 IKMA 副本：{0}。請只保留一個，刪除其餘副本，然後重新執行本程式。未做任何變更。

column1: {0} from another mod was saved as {1}.before-IKMA. Uninstalling IKMA puts it back.
column2: 來自其他模組的 {0} 已另存為 {1}.before-IKMA。解除安裝 IKMA 時會把它放回原處。

column1: Put back the earlier {0}.
column2: 已把先前的 {0} 放回原處。

column1: Note: a mod manager (r2modman or Thunderstore) is set up for Inscryption on this PC. If you start the game from the mod manager, add IKMA to that profile too; this installer set up the game started from Steam.
column2: 注意：這台電腦上為 Inscryption 設定了模組管理器（r2modman 或 Thunderstore）。如果你從模組管理器啟動遊戲，也請把 IKMA 加入那個設定檔；本安裝程式設定的是從 Steam 啟動的遊戲。

column1: Automatic: new versions download and install with no question.
column2: 自動：新版本會直接下載並安裝，不再詢問。

column1: Download, then ask before installing.
column2: 下載，然後在安裝前詢問。

column1: Ask before downloading.
column2: 在下載前詢問。

column1: Off: IKMA never connects to the internet.
column2: 關閉：IKMA 從不連線到網際網路。

column1: Automatic: your screen reader on Windows, the IKMA speech helper on a Steam Deck.
column2: 自動：在 Windows 上使用你的螢幕閱讀器，在 Steam Deck 上使用 IKMA 語音小幫手。

column1: Always your screen reader, through UniversalSpeech: NVDA, JAWS, or Windows speech.
column2: 一律使用你的螢幕閱讀器，透過 UniversalSpeech：NVDA、JAWS 或 Windows 語音。

column1: Always the IKMA speech helper, for Steam Deck and Linux.
column2: 一律使用 IKMA 語音小幫手，適用於 Steam Deck 和 Linux。

column1: Follow the game's language setting.
column2: 跟隨遊戲的語言設定。

column1: Off: the short log, what IKMA said and anything that went wrong.
column2: 關閉：簡短記錄檔，只有 IKMA 說過的話和出錯的內容。

column1: On: every diagnostic line, for a bug report. The log gets much longer.
column2: 開啟：所有診斷行，用於錯誤回報。記錄檔會變得長很多。
